# Introduction {#intro .unnumbered}

This is an **R Markdown** document: *emphasis*, __strong__, _also emphasis_, ***both***,
~~strikethrough~~, `inline code`, superscript^2^, subscript~2~, and a footnote.[^note]
Inline R: the week ending `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B")` had `r nrow(orders)` orders.
A parameter: `r params$warehouse`. Citations: [@smith2020; @jones2021, p. 12], @smith2020, [-@jones2021].

[^note]: The footnote body.

## Lists

- Unordered item
    - Nested item (four-space indent)
        - Deeper item
* Another bullet style
+ Third bullet style

1. Ordered item
2. Second item
    a. Nested lettered item
    b. Another
3. Third

- [ ] Task not done
- [x] Task done

Term
:   Definition of the term.

Second term
:   Another definition.

(@) Example list item
(@) Another example

## Headings

### Level three

#### Level four

##### Level five

###### Level six

Setext level one
================

Setext level two
----------------

[Inline link](https://example.com "Title"), <https://example.com>, [reference link][ref], and [a link with attributes](https://example.com){target="_blank"}.

![Alt text](logo.png){width=50% #fig-logo}

![A figure with caption](chart.png)

[ref]: https://example.com/reference "Reference title"

>

A fenced block without a language.

## Chunks

```{r load, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
orders <- read.csv("orders.csv")
paid <- orders %>% filter(status == "paid")
summary_tbl <- paid %>%
  group_by(status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), revenue = sum(total))
```

```{r plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=3, fig.cap="Paid orders", dev="png", out.width="80%"}
ggplot(paid, aes(number, total)) +
  geom_point(colour = "#336699") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```

```{r table, results='asis'}
knitr::kable(summary_tbl, caption = "Revenue by status", digits = 2)
```

```{r cached, cache=TRUE, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE, echo=-1}
Sys.sleep(1)
```

```{r opts, ref.label="load", echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
```

```{python py-chunk}
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({"sku": ["AC-1001"], "qty": [25]})
print(df)
```

```{bash shell-chunk}
ls -la | head -3
```

```{sql sql-chunk, connection=con, output.var="low_stock"}
SELECT sku, quantity FROM stock WHERE quantity < 10;
```

```

```

Paid orders: **`r nrow(paid)`**, revenue **`r sprintf("£%.2f", sum(paid$total))`**, mean `r round(mean(paid$total), 1)`.
